plain.li: [arrive,snow] Snow the whole way, and it's not done yet.
[arrive,night] Sorry to come knocking in the dark.
[arrive,hot] Is there any shade near this gate?
[arrive,fog] Couldn't see your gate until we were nearly on it.
[arrive,storm] That storm chased us the whole last mile.
[arrive,spring] Mud to the knees on every road this time of year.
[arrive,summer] Nothing but dust on the road since the river.
[arrive,fall] We wanted to get here before the roads turned bad.
[arrive,morning] We set off in the dark to be here this early.
[arrive,afterraid] We heard there was fighting here, is everyone all right?
[arrive,old] My legs aren't what they were, so I'll sit if I may.
[arrive,theirLowtech] Three days on foot from the river, and here we are.
[arrive,theirHightech] The map said there'd be a settlement here, and for once it was right.
[wait,rain] We'll keep under the wall, out of the rain, until you answer.
[wait,snow] The snow's settling on my shoulders out here.
[wait,hot] A cup of water while we wait wouldn't go amiss.
[wait,cold] I can't feel my feet, but I'll wait.
[wait,evening] It'll be dark soon, and I'd rather not walk back in it.
[wait,morning] No hurry, the day's still young.
[wait] Your people take their time over a thing, I'll say that.
[stay,winter] A night out of the wind, that's all we were hoping for.
[stay,rain] A dry corner, thank you, we'll be no trouble at all.
[stay,theirLowtech] We'll be gone before your fires are lit.
[stay] We'll keep to ourselves and leave the place as we found it.
[pass,rain] Heads down and keep moving, it's only rain.
[pass,snow] Walk in the tracks of the one in front.
[pass,night] Quiet going past, they'll be asleep in there.
[pass,hot] Water at the next ford, keep going.
[pass,animals] Keep the beasts on the road and out of their fields.
[pass] Nod to them as we go, it costs nothing.
[leave,rain] A wet road home, but it's home.
[leave,snow] If we go now we'll beat the worst of the drifts.
[leave,morning] An early start, and we'll be at the river by noon.
[leave,evening] We'll walk till dark and sleep by the road.
[leave,theirHightech] Back to the road, and the next dot on the map.
[leave] Thank your council for hearing us out.
[fire] Pass the pot round, there's enough for one more.
[fire,winter] Shift up, there's room by the fire if we squeeze.
[fire,rain] Wet wood, but it'll catch if you're patient.
[fire,night] Last stick on, then we sleep.
[fire,clear,night] Not a cloud tonight, look at those stars.
[arrive,rider] I've a message from my people, and I'm to wait for your answer.
[arrive,rider,winter] The ford froze over, so I came the long way round.
[arrive,rider,theirLowtech] Our headman sends his greetings, and a question.
[wait,rider] I'll rest my legs while your people talk it over.
[wait,rider,evening] If I set off by dark I'll be home by morning.
[wait,rider] My people will be watching the road for me.
[stay,rider] One night, and I'm off at first light.
[leave,rider] I'll carry your word back just as you gave it.
[leave,rider] Straight home, and no stopping on the way.
[arrive,driver] Long road, short pay, same as ever.
[arrive,driver,rain] The road's all mud from here to the river.
[wait,driver] I'm paid by the trip, not the hour, so take your time.
[wait,driver,animals] The beast could do with water, if it's no trouble.
[leave,driver] Back down the road before the light goes.
[leave,driver,animals] Up, you lazy beast, we're going home.
[arrive,drovers] We'll keep them well clear of your crops.
[stay,drovers] One of us sits up with the herd, we take turns.
[fire,drovers] Count them again in the morning, I make it one short.
[pass,drovers,animals] Steady them past the gate, don't let them spook.
[leave,drovers,animals] Get them moving, there's grass in the next valley.
[arrive,pilgrims,winter] Even the holy road is cold in winter.
[wait,pilgrims] Whatever you decide, we'll bless this gate.
[pass,pilgrims] Peace on this house, and on its fields.
[leave,pilgrims] We'll remember this house in our prayers.
[fire,pilgrims] One more hymn, then sleep.
[arrive,family] Stay close, all of you, and mind your manners.
[arrive,family,cold] Keep your hands in your sleeves while we wait.
[wait,family] Sit down, we may be here a while.
[stay,family] Everyone lie down, and no more talking.
[leave,family,morning] Up you get, it's a long way before supper.
[arrive,envoy] I speak for my people, and I'll speak to your council.
[wait,envoy] My people are patient, up to a point.
[leave,envoy] Your answer will be carried back word for word.
[arrive,runner,hot] Water first, then I'll tell you why I've come.
[wait,runner] I'll get my breath back while you decide.
[leave,runner] Downhill all the way home, at least.
[arrive,settlers] We're from the new place down the valley, your neighbors.
[arrive,settlers,theirLowtech] Three fields cleared and one house up, so far.
[wait,settlers] We know you're busy, we're busy too.
[leave,settlers] Come and see our place some time.
[wait,travelers] Anywhere out of the wind would do.
[stay,travelers,winter] We'll sleep in our coats, don't trouble yourselves.
[leave,travelers] We'll tell the next town where to find you.
[arrive,foreman] I've a crew waiting on me, so I'll keep it short.
[wait,foreman] My crew can't start until I bring them word.
[leave,foreman] Back to the crew, they'll want to hear it.
[wait,elder] I've waited longer for less, take your time.
[leave,elder] My knees thank you for the rest, and so do I.
[wait,herald] I am to wait for the colony's reply.
[leave,herald] My lord will have your answer as you gave it.
[arrive,hunters,theirLowtech] We follow the herd, and the herd came here.
[wait,hunters] The trail's going cold while we stand here.
[stay,hunters] We'll be up before the game is.
[leave,hunters] Good hunting country, this.
[fire,hunters] Tomorrow we try the far ridge.
[arrive,wardens] We keep the road, and the road brought us to you.
[wait,wardens] The road can spare us an hour.
[leave,wardens] Back to the road, it doesn't watch itself.
[pass,retinue] Heads up, and keep in line past the gate.
[pass,band] Look at the gate as we go, but don't stop.
[pass,band,theirLowtech] Blades stay sheathed, we're only passing.
[pass,herders,animals] Walk them slow, they've come a long way.
[stay,herders] The animals will sleep well on this grass.
[wait,singer] I'll hum while I wait, if nobody minds.
[stay,singer] A song tonight to pay for the roof, then.
[leave,singer] If you catch yourself humming it, think of me.
[glean,gleaners] Another handful, and the sack's half full.
[glean,gleaners] Slow and careful, mind the rows.
[leave,gleaners] Full sacks, and your fields none the worse.
[find,prospectors,winter] Cold water and colder hands, but there's color.
[find,prospectors] Not much, but it shines.
[pass,mourners] Keep it level on the slope.
[pass,mourners,rain] Keep the rain off them, as best you can.
[arrive,orphans] They're good children, they won't be any trouble.
[wait,orphans] Sit still now, the people here are deciding.
[arrive,carter] They even took my boots, can you believe it.
[wait,carter] A meal, that's all, then I'll walk on.
[arrive,reeve] The town asked me to come, or I'd not have troubled you.
[leave,tinker] Anything breaks, keep it for me till next time.

warm.li: [arrive] Thank you for seeing us at all.
[arrive] It's good to come to a place where people are at work.
[wait] Take your time, it's a lot to ask.
[wait] I'll keep out of everyone's way while you talk.
[stay] We'll leave your corner as clean as we found it.
[stay] You've been good to strangers, and we won't forget it.
[pass] We'll tell the road you let us by in peace.
[leave] Thank you, all of you, for the welcome.
[leave] If you're ever our way, ask for us by name.

blunt.li: [arrive] Let's get this done, I've a long walk back.
[arrive] I'll say it once, so listen.
[wait] I didn't walk all this way to stand at a gate.
[stay] A roof's a roof, I'm not fussy.
[stay] Nobody wake me before it's light.
[pass] Nothing to see here, keep walking.

cheerful.li: [arrive] Hello, the gate, is anybody home?
[arrive,clear] What a fine day for a walk!
[wait] I don't mind waiting, it's a pretty spot.
[wait] I'll count the clouds while your people decide.
[stay] A real roof tonight, I could sing.
[stay] Best offer I've had all month!
[pass] Lovely place, wish we could stop!
[leave] That was a good stop, we'll come this way again.
[leave,clear] Sun on our backs all the way home!

gloomy.li: [arrive] We've been turned away twice already this week.
[arrive,rain] Wet to the bone, and still a long way from anywhere.
[wait] They'll say no, they always do.
[stay] A night's sleep, then the road again.
[stay] It's more than most places would give us.
[pass] Another place we can't stop at.
[pass] Keep walking, there's nothing for us here.
[leave] The walk back is always longer.

cold.li: [arrive] I'm expected back, so be quick about it.
[wait] Your answer, when you have it.
[stay] A place to sleep, nothing more is needed.

plain.li: [play] Here's one my mother used to play.
[play] Sit a while, this one's short.
[play,night] A quiet one, so nobody's woken.
[play,winter] Cold fingers, so forgive the first few notes.
[play,theirLowtech] We've nothing like this at home, only pipes and drums.
[play,singer] You sing the chorus, I'll keep the tune.
[kill] Clean, it never knew a thing.
[kill,winter] Thin from the winter, but it'll do.
[kill,hunters] One more like that and we can go home.
[kill,theirHightech] One shot, that's how it's done.
[dress] Keep the liver, it's the best part.
[dress,winter] The cold will keep the meat, at least.
[dress,theirLowtech] The sinew's for bowstrings, the bones for needles.
[dress,night] Hold the light closer, I can't find the joint.
[buy] A fair price, and a fair stall.
[buy,clothes,winter] Something warm before the passes, good.
[buy,meal,winter] Food for a cold road, worth every coin.
[buy,drink,winter] Something to keep the cold out tonight.
[buy,medicine,pilgrims] For the sick we meet on the road.
[buy,roadfood,drovers] That'll see us to the next market.
[buy,rawfood,family] The children will eat well tonight.
[buy,textiles] Enough cloth for a new coat, at last.
[buy,art,theirHightech] Handmade, they'll love this back home.
[buy,metal,theirLowtech] Good metal's hard to come by where we live.
[dear] Maybe on the way back, if the road's been kind.
[dear,theirLowtech] We don't carry that much silver between us.
[none] I'll look again on the way back.
[none] Nothing on the counter I need, never mind.
[shrine] A shrine kept this clean says something about a place.
[shrine,theirLowtech] Your shrine is plainer than ours, but well kept.
[fields,summer] Tall crops already, you'll eat well this year.
[fields,fall] A good harvest coming, by the look of it.
[beasts] You've more beasts than my whole village.
[beasts,theirLowtech] Good beasts, well fed, someone here knows animals.
[art] Someone here has a good eye.
